options_2025.name: CORD
options_2025.details: Cord accent can be added to primary or secondary pillows on most styles.

options_2025.name: FRINGE
options_2025.details: Fringe accent can be added to primary or secondary pillows on most styles.

options_2025.name: LEG CHANGE
options_2025.details: Changes all standard legs to a different leg design.

options_2025.name: NAILHEAD TRIM - PLATINUM
options_2025.details: Platinum nailhead trim can be added to select styles.

options_2025.name: NAILHEAD TRIM - BLACK
options_2025.details: Hammered black nickel nailhead trim can be added to select styles.

options_2025.name: NAILHEAD TRIM - BRASS
options_2025.details: Brass nailhead trim can be added to select styles.

options_2025.name: NO NAILHEAD TRIM
options_2025.details: Nailhead trim can be removed from styles when it is a standard feature.

options_2025.name: CONTRASTING PILLOWS
options_2025.details: Fabric on accent pillows can be changed.

options_2025.name: CONTRASTING PILLOWS
options_2025.details: Fabric on second set of accent pillows can be changed on styles that come standard with two sets of pillows.

options_2025.name: FEATHERLITE PILLOWS
options_2025.details: Upgrades accent pillows to 95% duck feathers, 5% duck down, encased in a 100% cotton down-proof ticking (DPT) fabric.

options_2025.name: COMFORTCORE PLUS TEMPUR-RESPONSE Z5 MEMORY FOAM CUSHIONING
options_2025.details: Upgrades standard ComfortCore seat cushions to ComfortCore plus TEMPUR-Response Memory Foam seat cushions.

options_2025.name: COMFORTCORE PLUS TEMPUR-RESPONSE MEMORY ZB FOAM SEAT AND BACK CUSHIONING
options_2025.details: Upgrades standard ComfortCore seat cushions and backs to ComfortCore plus TEMPUR-Response Memory Foam seat and back cushioning.

options_2025.name: SLUMBERAIR MATTRESS
options_2025.details: Upgrade standard sleep sofa mattress with the SlumberAir Mattress System - Queen, Full & Twin Sizes.

options_2025.name: TEMPUR-RESPONSE MEMORY FOAM MATTRESS
options_2025.details: Upgrade standard sleep sofa mattress with the La-Z-Boy plus TEMPUR-Response Memory Foam mattress - Queen, Full & Twin Sizes.

options_2025.name: ARM CAP / HEADREST COVERS
options_2025.details: Quantities of napkin style arm caps and headrest covers are available with all fabric orders.

options_2025.name: EXTRA FABRIC
options_2025.details: Additional yards of fabric or complete leather hides can be ordered for decorative detailing or to keep on hand for repair.

options_2025.name: LEFT HAND POWER ACTIVATOR
options_2025.details: Changes the location of 2-button mounted controller with USB for operating the power recliner from right-side to left-side sitting.

options_2025.name: BATTERY PACK
options_2025.details: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery pack to power motion styles for cordless operation. Not available on lift chairs.

finishes_2025.name: Brown Mahogany
finishes_2025.details: The medium brown patina of this finish is a classic that easily mixes with other finishes in a room for an enduring look that never goes out of style.

finishes_2025.name: Coffee
finishes_2025.details: A deep rich finish with dark brown undertones, this sophisticated hue creates a contemporary vibe and an up-to-the-minute look.

finishes_2025.name: Graphite
finishes_2025.details: With understated gray tones that project a style that is both dramatic and modern, this finish makes a powerful design statement in any room.

finishes_2025.name: Driftwood
finishes_2025.details: This textured, lighter natural wood tone produces a more casual finish that is mixable within any room environment.
